test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 10 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. E sits third to the right of B. C sits to the immediate left of F. C is not an immediate neighbour of B. D sits to the immediate right of A. The position(s) of how many persons will remain unchanged if all persons are arranged in English alphabetical order in clockwise direction starting from A (including A)?
solution:
Given: A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

1) E sits third to the right of B. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e66f090a97ec855118416d2cef19078f7db7503715b3a592711bb568b7ab8dfa.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/89c38fa592ed74b1617c5045aebadb49baffe4e8c3efea918253d39306f7bb6e.png] 

2) C sits to the immediate left of F.

3) C is not an immediate neighbour of B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7e377ad81274c96813419b45e0ec90233673efa8f3fc68043724af04526cb20d.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e5f1d00e73d1dbeddfae4f208ae51d0ecc738af834c8b0d6809af2f323f29311.png] 

4) D sits to the immediate right of A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b408ac98878f1aec06c523e415ca6795a4916ce47531824d5c52cbc6286d8a24.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3c2d6efafbb37543f91b765d14a2f035d41ab89d9ed665fd30c2d9e195b551c7.png] 

So, if all persons are arranged in English alphabetical order in clockwise direction starting from A (including A):

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f151c1e663a8fb5279add4fc058c7876a2264287f4cf237254ce88782a3e3168.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cd1933a9c213f9000ea60e7787abf8979d99cdbf1a16381160398199cb4ae795.png] 

Thus, three people will remain unchanged if all persons are arranged in English alphabetical order in clockwise direction starting from A (including A).

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
